svg.aria-label: Pictorial breadboard wiring for the Life Catcher smart helmet prototype. An ESP32-WROOM-32 DevKit sits centre-right. Its left header carries the sensors on the DevKit's left column: MQ-3 alcohol sensor analog-out to GPIO36, clamped piezo to GPIO34, FSR divider to GPIO35, panic button to GPIO25, cancel button to GPIO26, active buzzer to GPIO27. Its right header carries 3V3 and GND to the breadboard rails, the MPU6050 GY-521 on I2C via GPIO21 and GPIO22, and the MQ-3 heater-switch transistor on GPIO23. Three inset schematics detail the piezo clamp, the FSR divider, and the MQ-3 heater switch.
svg.text: Phase 2 sensors + MQ-3 . generic ESP32-WROOM-32 DevKit v1 (30-pin) . pin order follows your board's silkscreen . mirrors firmware/include/pins.h
